title: Yuzu Margarita

items: ¾ oz yuzu juice, diluted as described in source
½ oz orange juice, for floating

steps: Rim half a stemless flute with smoked salt. The source specifies diluting yuzu with an equal part of water.
Shake yuzu, lime, agave, Cointreau and tequila with ice; strain into the iced glass. Float ½ oz orange juice on top.
If yuzu is unavailable, the source suggests ½ oz lemon juice, ½ oz lime juice and 2 dashes grapefruit bitters in its place.
sourceNote: Adapted from Fork & Fire cocktail recipes.
